rationale: Synthesizes all four required analyses: T1 (book description), T2 (denial analysis), T3 (provider/network comparison), T6 (high-cost model). Brief sections comprehensively cover findings, model performance, limitations, and next steps with conservative causal language and full citation for traceability. Report includes synthetic data, model limitations, and association-not-causation caveats; shows denominators for statistical discipline and cites artifacts for transparency.
